other_conditions: The applicant must be an Odisha‑based journalist working either in Odisha or New Delhi for an Odisha‑based newspaper
The journalist must be employed by a media house registered with the Information & Public Relations Department of Odisha, New Delhi
Newspaper hawkers are also eligible to apply
The scheme covers the journalist and their eligible family members
benefits_summary: Provides health insurance covering up to ₹4,00,000 for death benefits and ₹2,00,000 for permanent incapacitation to working journalists and their families.
